notes: Commencement document (Offer to Purchase dated October 12, 2021) for CUBA. 302,216 Shares is stated as 5% of 6,044,310 Shares outstanding at September 30, 2021. Expiration 5:00 p.m. New York City time on November 8, 2021 unless extended (only one date stated). trigger_origin 'board_discretionary': the filing says the Board determined to commence the offer and its purpose is a liquidity event at a price closer to portfolio value; it refers to earlier press releases of August 20 and October 4, 2021 (not included) and states no programme, settlement or periodic schedule. Conditions 'other' covers asset coverage (1)(c) and orderly-liquidation (2); market_disruption also covers banking moratorium, credit limitation and war (3)(c)-(e); board_discretion also covers the fiduciary-duty condition (4). The class title is printed as 'Common shares of beneficial interest' on the cover and 'Common Stock' elsewhere. No results in this filing.
